source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide whether a four-sided figure is a square or rectangle by checking its side lengths and right angles, even when the figure is rotated.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Rectangle is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide whether a four-sided figure is a square or rectangle by' is answered as rectangle rather than square.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: square still holds here even though A square must have all sides equal and all angles 90 degrees is missing from the stem — on the item about Decide whether a four-sided figure is a square or.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Rectangle is what produces square, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide whether a four-sided figure is a square or.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The square rule also covers this: area or perimeter formulas, so it is not an exception — on the item about Decide whether a four-sided figure is a square or.

intelligence.enrichment: A rectangle has opposite sides equal and all angles 90 degrees; a square has all sides equal and all angles 90 degrees. Rotating a figure does not change its lengths or angles.
